changesets.details: Publish placeholder: exercises the changeset flow, the release pull request, and crates.io publishing end to end before real changes ship through them. This release carries the whole platform — the yoga layout engine, the native renderer, the wasm runtime host, code push, the Axum server toolkit, the server-fn API, configuration, plugins, and the CLI — plus the release machinery itself.
